messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
You find two metal men. They sleep deep. Their eyes are dark.

One holds a key card. It glows faintly. You need power. The grid is dead. A battery lies here. It is old but works.

Place the cell in their chest. Sparks fly. One eye opens. It scans you. Its voice is cold. "Identify."

You speak your name. It nods. "Valid." The other android wakes up too. Both look at you. They step aside. A door slides open.

Inside, crates sit. Tech from before the fall. Guns, meds, chips. Take what you can carry. Leave quickly.
